scope.daemon: Three SIGTERM restarts of a real isolated child dockerd on the same data root and supervisor; Docker Desktop untouched.
scope.services: Same pinned outer and inner CA/PostgreSQL hosts, existing primary/standby and synchronous replication, gateways, leaf, standby, explicit workload and workers. No recreation, promotion, restore or key/epoch regeneration.
scope.admission: Current authenticated checkpoint and paired private cells must agree with current DB before admission. Originally closed admission and leaf pause preserved.
scope.private_snapshot: Only derived leaf/status.json.at is normalized. All other private bytes and status fields must agree and remain stable before/after cryptographic validation. Matching changes on both replicas still refuse.
scope.networks: A separate one-restart metadata probe confirmed regenerated builtin bridge ID. Durable network mode/aliases/config remain pinned; custom network ID replacement still refuses.
scope.dns: Additional tiny-container metadata probes isolated inherited DNS null-to-empty-list reloading. Only those equivalent forms normalize; explicit resolver changes still refuse. Final tiny probe proved same specs across stopped/restarted states on both none/custom networks.
scope.retry: Same stopped actor/journal after a second parent restart. After admission opens, new token consumption/revocation is preserved without old snapshot comparison or re-closing. Next full stop uses cycle2 with the same IDs/roles.
scope.security: Fresh real CA issuance, consumed-token/revoked-certificate denials and new nonce success. Post-open consumed token and revoked cert are checked unexpired. Historical synthetic-marker parent experiment is not counted.
scope.cost: Local Docker only; no AWS, paid LLM, real account, OS trust or detection threshold changes.

auxiliary_excluded_trials.reason: Tiny image files copied to Windows lost executable modes in the rootfs tar. Preparation failed with permission denied before any restart. Fixed explicit 0755 tar modes; not a service recovery result.

excluded_trials.reason: Sealing attempted to resolve the Linux control directory on Windows. Fixed by sealing inside the existing Linux worker under the authority lease; no scope/checkpoint guard was weakened. Superseded and not included in final totals.

Proactive review found completed/open retry could start stopped inner services while admission was already open. Abort fixture for a stricter read-only inner-health guard; no production acceptance criterion weakened. Owned parent was deliberately stopped during nested image preparation. Inner cleanup could no longer contact it; outer parent/data root/images were removed and the namespace was independently checked empty. Not a production recovery failure or success.

Live sealing refused unequal raw private-tree proofs before any daemon fault. Paused leaf still rewrites derived status observation time; new code normalizes only that timestamp and pins all other bytes before/after crypto checks. Final harness records per-file canonical differences rather than weakening or repairing replicas. Superseded; not added to final totals.

First real restart refused object fingerprint before service restoration. Tiny isolated probes identified inherited DNS null-to-empty reloading; normalize only those equivalent forms. Fixture error matching also required the final actual exception code and actor exit73, preventing a source-code string in a traceback from masquerading as a cut. Superseded; not counted as successful recovery.

limits: Same PC/kernel/trusted parent Docker and surviving data root, images and journals. Not physical-host, disk-loss or complete cold-restore recovery.
Checksums/Engine IDs are not authentication or Byzantine/full-state rollback protection. Socket users remain trusted administrators.
Explicit recovery; running/paused/unknown work, private replica/pending conflicts, partial online new outage and missing incomplete actor require investigation.
No arbitrary lease deletion, kill, busy reset, promotion, restore, business POST retry, automatic election/quorum or role/key regeneration.
SIGTERM process restarts do not prove every power-loss/SIGKILL timing; no production SLA/RTO/RPO or independent teammate review claim.
Separate persistent mTLS runtime automatic CA renewal integration and physical separation remain future scope.
